audit: Independent visual original-au/lo audit of assigned old image choice/matching questions, 2023–2025

scope.handoff: Originally42. The eight untouched2026 tail questions were reassigned by root to convert_2016; see old-graph-items-2026.json. No2026 content edited in this audit.

method: Opened every original source au and lo page for all34 assigned questions. Visually compared every actual originally referenced PNG, including3 legacy figures that were absent from initial inline-only inventory.

Compared source diagram/table data, graph shapes and labels, full crop boundaries/readability, original text/figure order, exact per-option content and ordering, answer mappings and corresponding official solution marks.

Re-cropped only from the original source PDF. Every new or changed final PNG was reopened visually after generation; before/after SHA and original page/region recorded. No whole-question screenshot substitutes.

Split composite graph choices into individual original option PNGs, preserving original column order. Removed obsolete composite prompt nodes and cleared migrated legacy figures arrays to prevent duplicates. Original composite PNG bytes are retained on disk.

Shared-context fixes repeat only original conditions/definitions/needed question diagrams in dependent prompts, without copying previous answers. No solution source diagram appears in a question prompt.

Twelve selected official Aufgabenpool PDFs from fresh root HTTP cache were additionally rendered and visually compared against original data/figures/options and printed IDs. Remaining official links use root live-check evidence, without claiming fresh visual review.

This is an image/choice/matching audit; it does not claim complete retranscription or independent verification of every non-choice calculation in the58subparts. Record status was not upgraded to reviewed. No schema4/client/manifest/ref changes by this reviewer.
